latin: Stat speciem cuius dicimur reminisci esse totaliter deperditam et abolitam.

mentions.context: This is part of the conceptual background behind Pico’s thesis but I could not find the reference to Avicenna in this context. Pico’s thesis could easily come from this discussion by Albert.
